data.one_liner: A customizable Cupertino‑style battery indicator widget.
data.what_it_does: Displays a battery icon that can represent any percentage value. The widget is highly customizable in colors and size and mimics the macOS menu‑bar battery design.
use_when: You need a simple visual representation of battery level in your UI
You want a lightweight, customizable widget without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need to read the device's actual battery state
You require complex animations or interactions beyond a static indicator
weaknesses: Does not provide real battery data
